question: Zeig mir als Balkendiagramm die zehn BBL-Spieler mit der besten Freiwurfquote in der Saison 2025–2026.
sql:
SELECT
  player_name,
  SUM(ftm) AS ft_made,
  SUM(fta) AS ft_attempted,
  ROUND(SUM(ftm) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(fta), 0), 1) AS ft_pct
FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
WHERE date_final >= '2025-07-15' AND date_final < '2026-07-15' AND competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
GROUP BY player_name
HAVING SUM(fta) >= 50
ORDER BY ft_pct DESC
LIMIT 10

question: Welches EuroLeague-Team hatte das beste Net-Rating in der Saison 2025–2026?
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE UPPER(team)
      WHEN 'CRVENA ZVEZDA MERIDIAN BELGRADE' THEN 'Crvena Zvezda Meridianbet Belgrade'
      WHEN 'PANATHINAIKOS ATHENS' THEN 'Panathinaikos Aktor Athens'
      WHEN 'BASKONIA VITORIA-GASTEIZ' THEN 'Kosner Baskonia Vitoria-Gasteiz'
      ELSE team
    END AS team,
    pts_per_poss_eigenes,
    pts_per_poss_gegner,
    anz_ballbstz_eigenes
  FROM gold.g_el_teams
  WHERE saison = '2025-2026'
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    SUM(pts_per_poss_eigenes * anz_ballbstz_eigenes) / SUM(anz_ballbstz_eigenes) AS pts_eigenes,
    SUM(pts_per_poss_gegner * anz_ballbstz_eigenes) / SUM(anz_ballbstz_eigenes) AS pts_gegner
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT
  team,
  pts_eigenes - pts_gegner AS net_rating
FROM merged
ORDER BY net_rating DESC
LIMIT 1

question:
Welches Team hat in der Bundesliga die größte Differenz zwischen erfolgreichen 2-Punkte Würfen und erfolgreichen 3-Punkte Würfen. 
Über alle Saisons
sql:
SELECT btrim(player_team) AS team,
       SUM(two_p) AS total_two_p,
       SUM(three_p) AS total_three_p,
       SUM(two_p) - SUM(three_p) AS diff
FROM bronze.b_bbl_boxscore
WHERE competition = 'easyCredit BBL'
GROUP BY player_team
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 1

question: Zeig mir die 5 Teams mit dem besten Offensivrating in der EuroLeague-Saison 2023/24.
sql:
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE UPPER(team)
      WHEN 'PANATHINAIKOS ATHENS' THEN 'Panathinaikos AKTOR Athens'
      ELSE team
    END AS team,
    pts_per_poss_eigenes,
    anz_ballbstz_eigenes
  FROM gold.g_el_teams
  WHERE saison = '2023-2024'
),
merged AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    SUM(pts_per_poss_eigenes * anz_ballbstz_eigenes) / SUM(anz_ballbstz_eigenes) AS offensive_rating
  FROM normalized
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT team, offensive_rating
FROM merged
ORDER BY offensive_rating DESC
LIMIT 5

question: Aus welchen Ländern kamen die meisten Punkte in der Champions-League-Saison 2025–2026?
sql:
WITH info AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (btrim(player_name))
         btrim(player_name) AS player_name, nationality
  FROM bronze.b_cl_player_info
),
saison AS (
  SELECT btrim(player_name) AS player_name, SUM(pts) AS punkte
  FROM bronze.b_cl_boxscore
  WHERE date >= '2025-07-15' AND date < '2026-07-15'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT i.nationality, COUNT(*) AS spieler, SUM(s.punkte) AS punkte
FROM saison s
JOIN info i USING (player_name)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY punkte DESC
doc: Joining a boxscore to a *_player_info table needs DISTINCT ON. player_info holds ONE ROW PER CRAWLED SEASON per player - 206 of 1165 Champions League players have 2-4 rows - so a plain JOIN fans out and multiplies their points by that row count. Verified against live data: without DISTINCT ON, USA came out at 17752 points instead of 9813, and the inflation is NOT uniform, so the ranking itself changes (Turkey rose from 6th to 3rd, Germany fell from 5th to 7th). Also note: player_info has NO season column, so the season must be filtered on the boxscore side and only then joined for the attribute - filtering player_info alone silently mixes every crawled season. Use btrim() on both sides of the name join; without it players with stray whitespace drop out entirely. Champions League has three profile tables (b_cl_player_info, _alt, _test) - b_cl_player_info is the canonical one.
